top_signals.title: Krugman Says France Poses Risk of Explosive European Debt Crisis
top_signals.summary: Nobel Prize-winning economist Paul Krugman warned that France’s deteriorating public finances are on an “unsustainble path” and at risk of unleashing a debt crisis across the euro area.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Leader of vast money mule operation that laundered cybercriminal proceeds pleads guilty
top_signals.summary: Oleg Korniev, a 42-year-old dual citizen of Ukraine and Russia, was a principal of Your Mule Cashout, or “YMCO,” which from 2007 until 2014 set up a sophisticated network of mules in the U.S. and Europe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Mobile payments firm Airtel Money had a bumpy debut as a London-listed company, sliding below its initial public offering price and coming up short of delivering a much-needed win for the UK’s stock exchange.
